# `bs list`

- **Usage:** `bs list [FLAGS] [SHELF]`

List bits, optionally sorted by creation or edit time

## Arguments
- **`[SHELF]`**

## Flags
- **`--sort <SORT>`** — Sort ascending by identifier (default), creation time or last edit

  **Choices:** `id`, `created`, `updated`
- **`--reverse`** — Reverse the selected order (newest first for timestamps)
- **`--tag <TAG>`**
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
